overall_notes: The paper focuses on generating geometric problems with aligned images and text. While it involves NLG tasks (question generation, code generation), the primary contribution is the dataset generation pipeline rather than novel NLG model development. The evaluation is comprehensive, using both automatic metrics (accuracy), LLM-as-judge (GPT-4V), and human evaluation. The metadata extraction was reasonably accurate but needed refinement to separate different types of evaluations and clarify which datasets are used for generation vs. evaluation.
